title: Building Up Independent Lives and Dreams Act
official_summary:
Building Up Independent Lives and Dreams Act or the BUILD Act

This bill allows nonprofit organizations offering mortgage loans for charitable purposes to use certain alternative forms to satisfy disclosure requirements.

summary.headline: A 2021 law lets certain nonprofit groups that make charitable mortgage loans use alternative forms to meet disclosure rules.
summary.what_it_does: The law applies to nonprofit organizations that offer mortgage loans for charitable purposes. It allows these groups to use certain alternative forms to satisfy disclosure requirements. The official summary does not describe the specific forms or the specific rules they replace.

who_it_affects.group: Nonprofit organizations that offer charitable mortgage loans
who_it_affects.how: They may use certain alternative forms to meet disclosure requirements instead of the standard forms.

who_it_affects.group: Borrowers who take out charitable mortgage loans from nonprofits
who_it_affects.how: The disclosure documents they receive may be in the alternative forms the law allows, but the summary does not say what information changes.
